## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Tech: 12/19 positive; Financials: 14/20 positive; Industrials: 11/13 positive; Materials: 6/7 positive; Energy: 7/8 positive; Consumer Disc.: 9/12 positive; Healthcare: 11/15 positive; Consumer Stpl.: 8/11 positive; Real Estate: 4/6 positive; Communication: 5/7 positive; Utilities: 2/6 positive. Confirmations: (1) Strong cross-market breadth (10/11) vs (2) pronounced mega-cap and tech divergences (AAPL, NVDA, AMD BELOW TREND) → CAUTION (conflicting signals).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Materials lead: FCX (1W: +8.86% | 1M: +26.18%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +8.49% | 1M: +13.93%) ABOVE TREND. Energy strong: SLB (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +18.02%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +12.08% | 1M: +5.68%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Discretionary strength: AMZN (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.54%) ABOVE TREND, HD (1W: +8.33% | 1M: +8.51%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology mixed with weakness at the top: AAPL (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -6.43%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -2.11% | 1M: -0.06%) BELOW TREND. Real Estate pockets weak: AMT (1W: -3.60% | 1M: -5.24%) BELOW TREND, CCI (1W: -5.67% | 1M: -6.14%) BELOW TREND. Utilities are the lone sector negative overall (Utilities: 2/6 positive).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC (1W: +15.67% | 1M: +12.47%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +18.02%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +12.08% | 1M: +5.68%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +12.74%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.54%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5) — cyclical tilt; Style: Value/Cyclical favored.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: AIG (1W: -10.49% | 1M: -0.78%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -9.08% | 1M: -8.33%) BELOW TREND, CCI (1W: -5.67% | 1M: -6.14%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -6.43%) BELOW TREND, ABBV (1W: -4.03% | 1M: -1.30%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select tech and insurance/financial names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strong 1W momentum: INTC (1W: +15.67% | 1M: +12.47%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +18.02%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +12.74%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence: MSFT (1W: +1.34% | 1M: -2.59%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL, META (1W: +0.41% | 1M: -0.51%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL, TSLA (1W: +1.58% | 1M: -0.04%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL — tactical moves, not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed with internal rotation; semis and select capex names strong while mega-cap consumer tech shows strain. AMAT (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +12.74%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +15.67% | 1M: +12.47%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -6.43%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -2.11% | 1M: -0.06%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: 12/19 positive.

8. Financials Outlook?
Broadly constructive but mixed at the stock level. JPM (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +10.04%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +0.95% | 1M: +7.13%) ABOVE TREND, CME (1W: -2.68% | 1M: -2.39%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: 14/20 positive.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Generally stable with idiosyncratic dispersion. UNH (1W: +2.25% | 1M: +6.30%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: -1.43% | 1M: +2.22%) TREND EXHAUSTION, ABBV (1W: -4.03% | 1M: -1.30%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: 11/15 positive.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclical Value exposure given leadership in Materials, Energy and Industrials (e.g., FCX, SLB, CAT) while reducing exposure to stretched/high-multiple tech names showing divergence (AAPL, AMD, NVDA). Maintain size discipline — CAUTION regime + strong breadth but concentrated leadership argues for selectivity and monitoring of mega-cap trend breaks.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +15.67% | 1M: +12.47%) ABOVE TREND — momentum and semiconductor setup; AMAT (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +12.74%) ABOVE TREND — capex read-through; PSX (1W: +8.88% | 1M: +1.63%) ABOVE TREND — refinery M&A catalyst. BEARISH: AAPL (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -6.43%) BELOW TREND — watch further distribution; AMD (1W: -9.08% | 1M: -8.33%) BELOW TREND — downside risk.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Materials (6/7 positive) and Energy (7/8 positive) — continued cyclical leadership. BEARISH: Utilities (2/6 positive) and select pockets of Tech (12/19 positive) — watch mega-cap dispersion.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA reclaim/fail the 1M trend (continuation would reduce caution); AAPL sustaining below its 1M trend keeps tech in risk; INTC/AMAT follow-through above this week’s breakout closes would confirm semiconductor leadership; SLB/PSX continuation above recent highs confirms energy rotation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
BA (+65): Boeing — large defense contract wins; BA (1W: +2.97% | 1M: +17.05%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. PSX (+55): Phillips 66 — refinery deal; PSX (1W: +8.88% | 1M: +1.63%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. DE (+50): Deere — deal and upgrades; DE (1W: +X% | 1M: +Y%) ABOVE TREND — catalyst noted (cross-check positional exposure). [Note: DE sentiment from feed; verify live levels.]

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
ABBV (-50): AbbVie downgrade; ABBV (1W: -4.03% | 1M: -1.30%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed and adding downside risk. QCOM (-50): Qualcomm downgrade; QCOM (1W: -X% | 1M: -Y%) — flag for Apple-supplier risk and watch near-term earnings cadence. BLK (-50): BlackRock political headline; BLK (1W: -X% | 1M: -Y%) — headline risk to monitor. [Note: QCOM/BLK recent 1W/1M stats to be checked in desk feed.]

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with a Value/Cyclical tilt. FCX (1W: +8.86% | 1M: +26.18%) ABOVE TREND and SLB (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +18.02%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: mega-cap tech divergence (AAPL, NVDA, AMD BELOW TREND) and select negative sentiment stories (ABBV downgrade) — monitor for trend breaks and news-confirmed distribution.
